zh-CN: 目录检查无变化时提示项目名，排队冲突说明更清楚，原位置可在打开旁修改。
二次压缩支持保留、更新或逐项确认备份位置，仅冲突任务等待确认。
缩略图按钮默认中档并循环大小；列表展示更多标签，提示避开返回按钮。
用户资料和仓库格式保持兼容，无需迁移。
en-US: Unchanged folder checks identify the item; queue conflicts are explained and originals can be edited beside Open.
Later compression can keep, update, or individually review backup locations; only conflicts wait for confirmation.
The thumbnail button defaults to medium and cycles sizes; list rows show more tags and toasts avoid the return button.
User data and Warehouse formats remain compatible; no migration is needed.
